question: Does covariance learned from physically co-observed heterogeneous historical tasks predict held source-task risk better than the original local prior and a covariance-scale-matched full dictionary?
fit: Four leave-pair-out fits. Each fit uses30 latent tasks from the other6 seeds, with both policy histories deduplicated as in A33. Within a task, precision-collapse distinct visits at the same candidate. Apply the unchanged fit_source_risk_ard marginal likelihood to eta labels only. Use the public96-point bank for seed48 for a common68-function normalization. Learn covariance and intercept, set all nonintercept means to zero. All five regimes enter without oracle support or regime-specific parameters.
prediction: For each held source task, original local I retains its two source-trained structural/full components. Q has the same local components with masses1/4,1/4 plus the heterogeneous covariance M with mass1/2. G uses the same components/masses and replaces M by B: identical intercept, discrepancy and total nonintercept covariance trace, spread uniformly over all68 functions. Prefix-only Bayesian weights, no q or population-mass fitting. Report standalone M/B as diagnostics. f/g and conditional-sharing models are unchanged.
analysis: Score only old paid steps9-24 on both fixed historical policy paths. Average policies within each latent task. Report Q-I and Q-G across all tasks and each regime, four outer seed-pair blocks,20,000 paired bootstrap resamples. Also report early/late differences, standalone M-I/B-I, optimizer convergence, learned high-frequency covariance mass and original-I reproduction. No source or target outcome is used to select a parameter or winning variant.
controls: Training task keys must exclude each held pair completely. Repeated-policy records enter source learning once, distinct visits retain their known measurement noise. Original I forecasts must match A28. Generic B must preserve learned M total coefficient variance, intercept, discrepancy and zero nonintercept mean. Evaluation seeds56-63 and all recommendation/verification outcomes are absent from all fits and scoring.
admission: After the first complete fold, project remaining3 folds and optional final fit with25 percent runtime margin and5 CPU seconds overhead. Stop if this exceeds90 CPU seconds. Retain any incomplete artifact; no automatic resubmission.
gate: Proceed to a final40-task covariance fit only if all four CV optimizers converged, overall Q-I and Q-G95 percent intervals are strictly positive, and no regime Q-I or Q-G interval is strictly negative. Passing supports only a source prediction candidate. Otherwise preserve the result and diagnose; no target/KG test.
limitations: This is development source validation with only four independent pair blocks and adaptive historical input selection. Gaussian eta label likelihood approximates bias-corrected log-chi-square noise. Public finite dictionary and pooled diagonal function covariance do not establish HVD or operational superiority.
